# 2 bed apartment for sale

> Buckley Real Estate are delighted to present Apt 5, 22 Railway Road to the sales market. This impressive 2 bedroom apartment extends to 86 sq. m. and offers bright, spacious accommodation finished to a modern standard throughout. The property features a particularly generous open-plan kitchen, living and dining area, with access to a private balcony.
